human_hints.title: Pad and hat intro
human_hints.summary: Pads and hats, almost no kick. No bass, no vocal.

human_hints.title: Possible intro shout (bar 1 beat 4) — low confidence
human_hints.summary: A lone vocal burst in the intro before the vocals start properly (first vocal phrase from about 7.4 s). Could be a shout or a vocal sample; weakest of the call candidates.

human_hints.title: Vocal verse, full beat
human_hints.summary: The vocal, kick and sub come in together. A continuous vocal over the full beat.

human_hints.title: Breakdown claps (bars 20-25)
human_hints.summary: Kick drops out; drums stem is claps on beats 2 and 4 only, 12 claps: 37.96, 38.89, 39.82, 40.77, 41.70, 42.63, 43.58, 44.51, 45.46, 46.39, 47.35, 48.27 (first one weakest). Bar 26 re-enters with kick on beats 3-4.

human_hints.title: Chorus drop
human_hints.summary: The full beat and sub return under the vocal hook. A snare fill closes it.

human_hints.title: Shout before drop 1 (bar 39 beat 4)
human_hints.summary: Short shout on the last beat before drop 1 lands at bar 40 (74.98); the vocal then stops for the drop.

human_hints.title: Instrumental hook
human_hints.summary: No sung vocal. The pads/lead hook takes over at full level over the beat.

human_hints.title: Drop 1 crowd calls (bars 40-47)
human_hints.summary: Crowd shouts on beat 4 every second bar, then held sung notes: single at bar 41 beat 4 (78.31); doubles beat 4 -> next beat 1 at bars 43-44 (82.05, 82.50) and 45-46 (85.75, 86.24); a longer one at bar 47 beat 4 (89.56) leading into the verse.

human_hints.title: Short break before verse 2
human_hints.summary: Drums, bass and pads dip. The vocal holds, then the build goes into verse 2.

human_hints.title: Vocal returns over the hook
human_hints.summary: The vocal comes back over the full beat.

human_hints.title: Verse 2, full beat
human_hints.summary: Vocal over the full beat and bass.

human_hints.title: Snare build into final chorus
human_hints.summary: The bass pulls out and a snare build leads into the last chorus.

human_hints.title: Shout before the clap bar (bar 79 beat 4)
human_hints.summary: Short shout on the last beat of the final chorus, just before the bar-80 clap and chant break.

human_hints.title: Clap + chant bar before final drop (bar 80)
human_hints.summary: One-bar break: kick out, claps on beats 2 and 4 (150.44, 151.37), and a short crowd call on every beat (150.00, 150.54, 150.97, 151.44). The strongest crowd moment in the song; drop lands on bar 81 (151.86).

human_hints.title: Drop 2 crowd calls (bars 81-88)
human_hints.summary: Same call pattern as drop 1: single at bar 82 beat 4 (155.18); doubles beat 4 -> next beat 1 at bars 84-85 (158.93, 159.38), 86-87 (162.67, 163.12) and 88-89 (166.43, 166.88), each followed by held sung notes.

human_hints.title: Instrumental break, vocal out
human_hints.summary: The vocal stops. The beat and pads carry the hook.

human_hints.title: Last vocal over the beat
human_hints.summary: The vocal returns for the final lines over the full beat.

human_hints.title: Ending, beat drops
human_hints.summary: Bass and drums drop away. The vocal and pads finish.

human_hints.title: Outro accent hits (bars 90 and 92, beat 4)
human_hints.summary: Kickless outro with two isolated full hits on beat 4: bar 90 (170.13, with a vocal call at 170.15 on the same beat) and bar 92 (173.89, the last hit of the song). Kick plus mid, so accent hits, not claps.
